<thought>Using the most intense ESI peak (m/z 211.0764) as the [M+H]⁺ ion, the neutral mass is ≈210.069 Da. The formula C₁₄H₁₀O₂ matches this mass within 0.001 Da and gives an M+1 intensity consistent with the observed isotopic pattern. Therefore the molecular formula is C14H10O2.</thought>
<final_answer>C14H10O2</final_answer>
